evidence: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry was used at a fixed angle of incidence of 61° for in situ monitoring of the evolving thickness and optical properties of the films during ALD. Grazing-Incidence X-ray Diffraction (GI-XRD) was carried out using a Siemens D5000 equipped with an X-ray mirror and a parallel plate collimator. Raman Spectroscopy was performed in a Renishaw inVia confocal Raman microscope. The surface morphologies of the films were examined by field-emission scanning electron microscopy (SEM).
